lines.beaver: 민수 씨, 요즘 얼굴이 많이 피곤해 보여요.
lines.beaver_en: Minsu, you look really tired these days.
lines.beaver_roman: Minsu ssi, yojeum eolguri mani pigonhae boyeoyo.
lines.learner: 네, 요즘 매일 야근해서 좀 힘들어요.
lines.en: Yes, I work late every day these days, so it's hard.
lines.roman: Ne, yojeum maeil yageunhaeseo jom himdeureoyo.

lines.beaver_en: What did you take on that's so much?
lines.en: I'm in charge of training newcomers and a new project.

lines.beaver_en: Wow, do you go on business trips too?
lines.learner: 네, 다음 주에 부산으로 출장을 가요.
lines.en: Yes, I'm going on a business trip to Busan next week.
lines.roman: Ne, daeum jue busaneuro chuljangeul gayo.

lines.beaver: 과장님께 일을 줄여 달라고 해 봤어요?
lines.beaver_en: Did you ask the section chief to cut your work?
lines.beaver_roman: Gwajangnimkke ireul juryeo dallago hae bwasseoyo?
lines.learner: 말해 봤는데 과장님은 뭐든지 저한테 맡기세요.
lines.en: I tried, but the section chief gives me everything.
lines.roman: Malhae bwanneunde gwajangnimeun mwodeunji jeohante matgiseyo.

lines.beaver_en: Still, do you get a bonus?
lines.learner: 네, 우리 부서는 연말에 보너스가 나와요.
lines.en: Yes, our department gets a bonus at year's end.
lines.roman: Ne, uri buseoneun yeonmare boneoseuga nawayo.

lines.beaver: 다행이네요. 그래도 근무 시간이 너무 길죠?
lines.beaver_en: That's good. But the working hours are too long, right?
lines.beaver_roman: Dahaengineyo. Geuraedo geunmu sigani neomu giljyo?
lines.learner: 네, 제가 과장이라면 근무 시간을 줄일 거예요.
lines.en: Yes, if I were the section chief, I'd cut the hours.
lines.roman: Ne, jega gwajangiramyeon geunmu siganeul juril geoyeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Haha, do other people work late like that too?
lines.en: In our department, even newcomers often work late.

lines.beaver_en: I see. Then I'll help you a bit.
lines.en: Thanks. Can I ask you for anything at all?

lines.beaver_en: Of course. We're in the same department.
lines.learner: 좋은 직장 동료가 있어서 정말 다행이에요.
lines.en: I'm so glad to have a good coworker.
lines.roman: Joeun jikjang dongnyoga isseoseo jeongmal dahaengieyo.

lines.beaver_en: Don't work late today; go home early.
lines.learner: 네, 직장인도 쉬어야죠. 오늘은 일찍 갈게요.
lines.en: Okay, office workers need rest too. I'll leave early.
lines.roman: Ne, jikjangindo swieoyajyo. Oneureun iljjik galgeyo.
